title: Phasing
wikitext:
{{status
| name                   = Phasing Buff
| type                   = Buff
| icon                   = Phasing status icon.png
| description            = You have Phasing, allowing you to move through enemies.
}}

'''Phasing''' is a boolean [[stat]]. Phasing entities can move through enemies, but still obstruct the movement of enemies without phasing.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/e7hg0u/ggg_can_we_have_skitterbots_count_as_minioms_for/fa105xk/?context=999</ref> 

Phasing is not inherently a [[buff]],<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/5gzfwo/allies_cannot_die_aura_should_be_removed_from/daxfkgz/</ref> and accordingly has no buff icon when granted by non-buff sources (e.g. {{il|Quartz Flask}}). It does not have a visual effect,<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1669519/filter-account-type/staff</ref><ref>[[Version 3.13.1c]] patch notes</ref> though some sources can grant it one.

==Gems==
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=active
|stat_id_query=%phase%
|stat_page=phasing
}}

==Base items==
{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables=item_buffs
|join=items._pageID=item_buffs._pageID
|where=
  items.stat_text LIKE "%phasing%"
  OR item_buffs.stat_text LIKE "%phasing%"
}}
==Unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

==Modifiers==
===Abyss jewels===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%abyss_jewel%"
|spawn_weights=1
}}

===Influence mod===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
  AND 
(mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%elder%" OR 
mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%adjudicator%" )

|spawn_weights=1
}}
===Synthesis mod===
{{modifier table
|q_tables=spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where =mods.stat_text LIKE "%phasing%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%"
|stat_text=1
|level=1
}}
===Other===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%abyss_jewel%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%elder%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%adjudicator%"
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type= 1
}}

==Passive Skills==
These [[passive skill]]s are related to Phasing:

===Base passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
}}

===Ascendancy passives===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%phasing%"
}}
